output.description: Moves a closed matter's document folder from the active matters share into the records archive, under a folder for the year it closed, adding a numbered suffix if that name is already in the archive. Before moving, it permanently deletes Office temp files (~$*) and system junk files (Thumbs.db, .DS_Store, desktop.ini) from the folder.
output.declaring_phrase: permanently deletes Office temp files (~$*) and system junk files
